title: Geologic map of the Winnsboro Mills quadrangle, Fairfield County, South Carolina
citation: Secor, D.T., Jr., Barker, C.A., and Howard, C.S., 2016, Geologic map of the Winnsboro Mills quadrangle, Fairfield County, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Geologic Quadrangle Map GQM-54, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
Single OCR map sheet with explanation, two cross sections and references; Piedmont bedrock. Map face is noise. Symbols legible inline: Qal, Zsm, Zpft2, Zfa, Zs (in text); Jd and Cwqm taken from the correlation chart (inferred); Zers1, Zpftt and Dgrn read as Z€rs1, Zpft1 and Dgm (OCR misreads, flagged and sent to review); other symbols (megacrystic granite, syenite, gabbro, metadiabase, greenstone, mylonitic gneiss, schist, metagabbro, upper Richtex) illegible. U-Pb ages printed with '+' read as '±' and sent to review. Folds and foliation symbols in the explanation are legend only and not recorded. Correlation chart Silurian unit ('[RGI]OGR') illegible.
SUBSURFACE: sections A-A' and B-B' (page 1) are drawn to sea level with axes +4000 to -3000/-4000 feet and +1220 to -1220 meters; alluvial deposits not shown; distances and unit boundary elevations along them not legible. Base map 1927 North American Datum, contour interval 10 feet.
